The Pax Inguinales Program Committee has instituted a series of evening salons to complement
the scientific presentations.
These salons are fashioned after the French salons of the 1920s, during which unemployable
American expatriates with English majors feigned artistic achievement.
The Inguinal salons are informal discussions led by experts in the field of herniology,
covering a wide array of timely topics.
These meetings are conducted in a non-threatening, gender-neutral, socially conscious, and environmentally
safe manner paying full attention to the ethno-cultural and psycho-social development
and background of the participants.
The salons will be free of focus groups, breakout sessions, and facilitators.
The Inguinal Salon Series will be held each evening from 2100 hours dot 2200 hours
at the Cafe Pino.
